contract.note: The plain reading (reliable physical consistency across varied situations, not flawless output) is ordinary and fair. Treating the claim as an open-ended forecast with an early-contradiction rule is appropriate.

evidence.note: An independent 2026 preprint that includes Sora 2 Pro reports large remaining coherence failures. This bears on current capability but cannot prove permanent inability, and it gives no Sora-only rate.

reviews.rationale: This is an unlimited negative forecast with no deadline.
